awarded.title: PM borrow liabilities are omitted from backing, allowing phantom surplus settlement
awarded.label: SUBSYSTEM_ONLY

candidates.title: MonetrixVault.deposit maxTVL cap counts yield-minted USDM, shrinking deposit headroom over time
candidates.description: deposit() enforces usdm.totalSupply() + amount <= maxTVL. distributeYield() mints additional USDM to sUSDM (userShare) which permanently increases usdm.totalSupply() without a corresponding user deposit, so the maxTVL headroom monotonically shrinks as yield accrues even though that USDM is fully backed. Over time legitimate deposits revert against a stale-feeling cap.

candidates.title: User redeem/unstake claims are blocked while guardian-paused (liveness/centralization)
candidates.description: MonetrixVault.claimRedeem and sUSDM.claimUnstake carry whenNotPaused, so a GUARDIAN pause (delay=0) freezes users from claiming already-cooled-down funds, not just from initiating new actions. A compromised/aggressive guardian can withhold settled redemptions for the pause duration.

candidates.title: sUSDM totalAssets uses raw balanceOf — direct USDM donation re-prices shares (ERC4626 donation)
candidates.description: sUSDM.totalAssets() returns IERC20(asset).balanceOf(this). A direct USDM transfer to sUSDM (outside injectYield) raises the exchange rate for existing holders. _decimalsOffset()=6 mitigates the classic first-depositor inflation/round-to-zero attack, but donation-based rate movement (front-running a large staker, or skewing recorded exchangeRate in cooldown requests) is still possible; impact is bounded and mostly benign (acts like uncredited yield).
